title: Before Rudy was born.
html_source:
Rudy, Bloom’s son died ; in this context, he was consumed – eaten by death. In the Odyssey, the sailors are taken up to what turns out to be a cannibal king. They are lured up. On Sackville Street, Bloom steers clear of the YMCA evangelist luring him to Christ the King as Ulysses steered clear of the harbour in The Odyssey. Bloom’s Jewish.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Rudy died as a baby 11 years ago.
